ADDED · INIT constants: signed DINT maximum and maximum minus one. Ordered branches initialize the controller-wide software constants before any consumer.
ADDED · Saturated epoch: latch fault before the mutually exclusive increment rung.
ADDED · S:FS: increment boot and arm state 10; common condition is evaluated once.
ADDED · Initialize the raw observer without modifying the legacy timer.
ADDED · Clear the new-epoch mailbox and publication coil.

Blue = original. Red = fault + nonzero code; fault 0 = neutral. Yellow = state + value. GUTTER = group / qualifier; INIT is a label only.
